headline: Liquidity of Indonesian Banks in the Spotlight, Here's OJK's Explanation
summary: Indonesia's financial regulator OJK has explained current liquidity conditions in the banking sector after Likuiditas Bank drew attention. The source gives no further detail.
why: Liquidity levels determine whether banks can meet withdrawals and lending demand. Regulator statements on liquidity can affect confidence in individual lenders and the wider banking system.
original_headline: Likuiditas Bank RI Jadi Sorotan, Begini Penjelasan OJK
